subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Introduced to the diamond shape (sides and corners)

show.line: This is a diamond. Four sides and four pointy corners. Like a kite in the sky!

rounds.prompt: What shape is this? Say it with me. Diamond!
Touch each corner of the diamond. How many corners?
Which toy is a diamond? Look for the pointy corners.
rounds.praise: Yes! A kite is a diamond.

rounds.prompt: Put the diamonds in one group and the circles in the other.
Find the diamond again. It stands on one point.

hints: A diamond has four pointy corners.
A diamond stands on its point, like a kite.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the diamond.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: This one! It sits flat on its side, so it is a diamond.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is a square. A diamond stands on its point.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. A diamond has a point at the top and the bottom.

parent_line: Can recognise and name a diamond shape.
